subtitle: Granular Shimmer and Diffuse Tail
tagline: Pitch-shifted, reversible grains climb through filtered feedback and bloom into an eight-line diffuse tail, from distinct sparks to a wide, floating cloud.

body.lead: TB Shimmer cuts the incoming sound into short grains, transposes them, and feeds them back so that each new generation climbs again. The grains then pass through an early diffuser into an eight-line late tail, so the result can move from separate sparks to a smooth, rising cloud.

body.p: The upper row shapes the grains: `TIME`, `SIZE`, and `DENSITY` set where, how long, and how often grains play, `SCATTER` spreads them, and `LEVEL VAR`, `POSITION RAND`, and `PITCH SPRAY` vary each grain. The lower row sets the shimmer: `PITCH`, `REVERSE`, `FEEDBACK`, `TONE`, `WIDTH`, and `MIX`. TB Shimmer works on mono or stereo tracks, reports no latency, and needs no external feedback routing.

ul: Windowed grains read from the recent input, 60 to 1200 ms behind it
PITCH from −12 to +24 semitones, with a REVERSE chance per grain
Pitch-shifted feedback through a TONE filter, so grain generations keep rising
Early all-pass diffuser and an eight-line late tail with a decay of up to 45 seconds
Per-grain level, position, and pitch randomisation
Live GRAIN HALO display driven by the parameters
100 factory presets in 14 groups, user presets, undo, and redo

note.title: About this manual
text: This manual describes TB Shimmer 1.0.0 for Windows (VST3 and standalone). The current macOS build (AU and VST3) is also version 1.0.0; small differences between platforms are possible.

ol: Insert TB Shimmer on a pad, guitar, vocal, or keys track, or on an effects return. The defaults are `PITCH` +12 st, `FEEDBACK` 42%, and `MIX` 48%.
Choose a preset from the preset list {{1}}, or start from Init.
Set the grain pattern with `TIME`, `SIZE`, and `DENSITY` {{3}}. Low DENSITY gives separate grain echoes; high DENSITY gives a smooth wash.
Choose the interval with `PITCH` {{6}}, then raise `FEEDBACK` {{8}} to let the shimmer climb and the tail grow.
Shape the tail with `TONE` and `WIDTH`, and set the balance with `MIX` {{9}}. On an effects return, set MIX to 100%.

rows: Sets how far behind the input each grain begins. Short times stay close to the source; long times give separate, delayed grain echoes.
Sets the grain duration and the scale of the diffuse space. Short grains sound grainy and articulate; long grains blend smoothly.
Grains per second. Moves from sparse grain echoes to a smooth, dense wash. DENSITY also sets how much diffusion and late tail are mixed in.
Varies grain size, spreads grains across the stereo field, and adds slow motion inside the diffuse tail.
Lowers each grain's level by a random amount, up to the selected value.
Randomises each grain's read-start position around TIME.
Spreads each grain's pitch continuously around the main PITCH setting.
−12 to +24 st in semitone steps · +12 st
Transposes the grain cloud. With FEEDBACK, each new generation is transposed again, so the shimmer keeps rising (or falling with negative values). At 0 st there is no pitch shift.
Sets the chance that a grain reads backward.
Extends both the rising grain generations and the diffuse decay. The tail can last up to 45 seconds.
Damps each tail circulation and sets the brightness of the wet signal. Lower values give a darker, softer tail.
Sets the stereo spread of the combined grain and tail field. At 0% the wet field is mono, as in the Mono Bloom preset.
Blends the dry input with the granular shimmer and diffuse tail.

body.p: TB Shimmer also has a host Bypass parameter. There is no bypass button on the panel.

tip.text: PITCH +12 st gives the classic octave shimmer, +7 st a fifth, and +19 st an octave plus a fifth. Negative values make the tail fall instead of rise.

warn.text: High FEEDBACK with long TIME and SIZE can build a long, loud tail. Raise FEEDBACK gradually and watch the output level.

body.p: Step through presets with the arrows, or open the list to browse the factory groups and your user presets. Save asks for a name and stores the current settings as a .tbshimmer file in Documents/TB_Shimmer/Presets/User; if the name exists, you are asked before it is replaced. Undo and Redo step through recent parameter changes. The factory presets also appear in the host's program list.

body.p: The UTILITY presets Wet Shimmer Bus and Wet Diffuse Bus use MIX 100% for effects returns. The PULSE presets use TIME values that match note lengths at 120 BPM, such as 500 ms for a quarter note; TIME does not follow the host tempo.
Starting points for common jobs. Adjust them by ear.

recipes.title: Octave shimmer
recipes.use: A rising octave halo on pads or guitar.
steps: Lower TONE if the top end gets brittle.

recipes.title: Vocal sheen
recipes.use: A subtle lift behind a lead vocal.
steps: Keep SCATTER low so the words stay clear.

recipes.title: Reverse swell
recipes.use: Backward swells that rise out of a guitar part.
steps: Longer SIZE makes the swells smoother.

recipes.title: Shimmer return
recipes.use: One shimmer send shared by several tracks.
steps: Insert TB Shimmer on an effects return and set the send level on each track.

rows: The tail grows too long or too loud.
Lower FEEDBACK, shorten TIME or SIZE, or lower MIX.
The shimmer is harsh or brittle.
Lower TONE, reduce PITCH SPRAY, or try +7 st instead of +12 st.
Raise SCATTER, POSITION RAND, or PITCH SPRAY slightly.
The sound is too wide or weak in mono.
The repeats do not follow the song tempo.
TIME is free-running. Set it by ear, or calculate it: 60000 ÷ BPM gives one quarter note in milliseconds.
MIX is at 0% or the host Bypass parameter is on.
First release: octave-up granular voices with an early diffuser and an eight-line late tail; Level Var, Position Rand, and Pitch Spray; 100 factory presets; versioned preset and state migration.
